goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Manual Lymphatic Drainage is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Manual Lymphatic Drainage kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD) is a very gentle massage that stretches the skin lightly to encourage lymph flow. It starts near the lymph nodes to make room, then works from the body toward the limb ends, directing strokes back toward the nodes. It is part of a bigger lymphedema program.
text.ur: Yeh specialized, gentle skin-stretch techniques hain jo comprehensive lymphedema management mein trained clinicians use karte hain.

simpler.en: Very light, slow skin-stretching strokes that move fluid toward the lymph nodes, done in a set order.
simpler.ur: Manual Lymphatic Drainage mein bohat halkay, rhythmical skin-stretch strokes use hotay hain aur yeh lymphedema ke comprehensive management ka ek hissa hai.

text.en: Think of emptying a hose: you first clear the drain at the end, then gently squeeze the hose from the far end toward the drain.
text.ur: Pipe khali karne jaisa socho: pehle aakhir wala drain saaf karte hain, phir pipe ko door wale sire se drain ki taraf aahista dabate hain.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Pressure is very light, because lymph vessels lie just under the skin.
**2.** Sequence is key: clear the neck or groin and nodes first, then the limb.
**3.** MLD works best with compression bandaging, exercise and skin care.
text.ur: Maqsad lymphatic fluid movement aur edema management ko support karna hai. Aam tor par yeh complete decongestive therapy ka ek hissa hota hai, akela treatment nahi. Long-term control mein compression, exercise, skin care aur self-management bhi central ho sakte hain.

question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Lymphedema** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en:
So when does **Manual Lymphatic Drainage** make sense?
• Lymphedema, usually with medical guidance.
• Swelling after some surgeries when cleared by the medical team.
text.ur: Medical assessment ke baad selected lymphedema; cancer treatment ke baad swelling jab medical team clearance de.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Acute infection, such as cellulitis, or acute blood clot.
• Uncontrolled heart failure or kidney failure, unless cleared.
• Active cancer in the area or unexplained swelling without a diagnosis.
text.ur:
Cardiac ya renal disease, nazuk skin, aur cancer-related ehtiyat jahan medical coordination chahiye.
Acute cellulitis, untreated DVT, acute decompensated heart failure, ya nayi unexplained swelling jiska medical assessment na hua ho.
Sudden unexplained swelling, suspected infection, acute thrombosis, breathlessness ya significant cardiac/renal concerns mein medical assessment zaroori ho sakta hai. Contraindications aur precautions ko trained clinician ke saath screen karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Check medical clearance and skin
steps.detail: Confirm diagnosis, check for infection and clots.

steps.title: Prepare the drainage areas
steps.detail: Use gentle strokes at the base of the neck and the nearest nodes.

steps.title: Work proximal first
steps.detail: Start with the part closest to the body, such as upper arm.

steps.title: Move toward the distal end
steps.detail: Use light strokes in the direction of the nodes, moving gradually toward the hand.

steps.title: Keep pressure very light
steps.detail: The skin should move without redness.

steps.title: Compress and move
steps.detail: Apply compression garments or bandages and encourage gentle exercise.

beats.ur:
1. Swelling ki wajah aur medical contraindications screen karein.
2. Munasib drainage sequence ke mutabiq halkay, rhythmical skin-stretch strokes dein.
3. Nazuk tissues ko nuqsan se bachane ke liye deep pressure na dein.
4. Indication ho to compression aur therapeutic exercise ke sath combine karein.
5. Limb response measure karein aur self-management samjhayein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: 30-45 minute sessions, frequency set by the lymphedema plan. Pressure is very light, similar to the weight of a hand resting.
text.ur: Session ka duration aur frequency lymphedema ki severity, care ke phase aur compression plan par depend karti hai. Individual clinical planning zaroori hai.

beats.patient: Fiona, 60, mild swelling in her right arm after breast cancer surgery, cleared by her care team.
beats.assessment: Skin is intact with no infection signs. Arm is mildly swollen.
beats.treatment: You clear the neck and armpit area, then do light strokes from upper arm toward the hand, followed by compression.
beats.reassess: Arm circumference decreases a little and the heavy feeling eases. She does exercises and skin care.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Agar kisi patient ke limb mein swelling ho, to pehla qadam cause aur red flags ka medical assessment hai. Sirf swelling dekh kar drainage shuru nahi ki jati. Yeh example safety principle samjhata hai, treatment prescription nahi.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Pressing too hard.
• Starting at the swollen end.
• Treating without a medical diagnosis.
text.ur:

text.en: MLD can help some patients with lymphedema as part of a combined program, but evidence that it adds much beyond compression and exercise is mixed.
text.ur: Selected lymphoedema cases mein MLD broader decongestive care ka hissa ho sakti hai; compression, exercise, skin care aur education ki zaroorat diagnosis par depend karti hai. Results ko swelling, symptoms aur function se monitor karein.
